preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The number of cities is between 2 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
The number of roads is between 0 and 120000, inclusive.
The city numbers are between 1 and N, inclusive, and the source node S is also a city number.

preconditions.expression: No nodes will have a road to itself.
preconditions.description: There are no self-loops in the graph.

preconditions.expression: There will not be multiple edges between any pair of nodes.
preconditions.description: There is at most one undirected edge between any pair of nodes.

preconditions.expression: Graph is guaranteed to be sparse.
preconditions.description: The graph is guaranteed to be sparse, meaning the number of edges is less than the maximum possible number of edges for a graph with N nodes, which is N * (N - 1) / 2.

preconditions.expression: There will be a path between any pair of nodes using the side lanes.
preconditions.description: It is guaranteed that there will be a path between any pair of nodes using the village roads.

postconditions.expression: Output consists of T lines, each with N-1 space-separated integers.
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output consists of N-1 space-separated integers, representing the shortest distances from the source node S to all other nodes using the village roads.

postconditions.expression: Distances are calculated as the number of village roads between any two places.
postconditions.description: The distances are calculated as the number of village roads (side lanes) between any two places in the city.

postconditions.expression: Distances are in ascending order based on vertex number.
postconditions.description: The distances are printed in ascending order based on the vertex number of the destination nodes.
